title: Singularity Mall

zones.name: Arrival Court
zones.description: A sheltered threshold with a clear view into the central atrium.

zones.name: Grand Atrium
zones.description: The social heart of the pavilion: daylight, gathering space and a directory of the surrounding promenade.

zones.name: Maker Promenade
zones.description: Small storefronts for independent makers, creators and specialist merchants.

zones.name: Market Hall
zones.description: Food, daily goods and neighborhood commerce around a shared seating court.

zones.name: Upper Gallery
zones.description: A quieter second-level walk overlooking the atrium and event floor.

zones.name: Event Terrace
zones.description: A flexible venue for demonstrations, launches, workshops and seasonal gatherings.

storefronts.name: Civic Quarter Bakery
storefronts.description: A neighborhood cooperative serving the daily loaf and market roll basket. Its catalog is read from the shared City market fixture.

storefronts.name: Maker Studio
storefronts.description: A proposed storefront for Workshop creators to exhibit original objects, tools and small-run creations.

storefronts.name: Field & Fable
storefronts.description: A proposed bookshop and curiosity cabinet for maps, field guides, tabletop books and unusual discoveries.

storefronts.name: The Greenhouse Table
storefronts.description: A proposed café and community table opening onto the market hall.

limitations: The pavilion is an authored spatial and navigation prototype, not a live 3D world.
Only Civic Quarter Bakery has a storefront reference into the current Economy market fixture.
The remaining storefronts are leasing concepts, not registered merchants or available products.
No purchase, payment, inventory reservation or settlement is performed by this browser experience.
